dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans, members of the Selected Reserve, and members of the All-Volunteer Force pursuing apprenticeships or on-job training, particularly in the construction industry.
dimensions.evidence: eligible individuals who choose to pursue programs of apprenticeship or other on-job training instead of a four-year college degree

dimensions.assessment: Modifies how housing stipends and monthly educational assistance allowances are calculated for participants in training programs.
dimensions.evidence: a monthly housing stipend equal to the monthly amount of the basic allowance for housing payable under section 403 of title 37

dimensions.assessment: Alters the computation of housing stipends and educational assistance percentages, implying changes to federal benefit outlays.
dimensions.evidence: is amended by striking 'this chapter is--' and all that follows through the period at the end and inserting the following: 'this chapter is 100 percent of the monthly educational assistance allowance'

dimensions.assessment: Amends specific sections of title 38 and title 10 of the United States Code related to veterans' educational assistance.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, and title 10, United States Code, to eliminate those provisions relating to veterans educational assistance

dimensions.assessment: Permanent changes to veterans' education and training benefit formulas.

missing_information: The source material does not provide a Congressional Budget Office cost estimate or total projected spending figures.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends veterans' educational assistance titles under U.S. Code to adjust monthly housing stipends and educational allowances for individuals pursuing apprenticeships or on-job training, and waives minimum attendance requirements for construction industry apprenticeships.
